Subject: Trial credit top-up & activation help

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the quick trial access last week. We started some early experiments but our engineers ran into an issue where the integration used the wrong API key and a lot of calls failed — long story short we only consumed ~12% of the trial allocation and we’re blocked from running the end-to-end workload we promised stakeholders.

Is there a one-time top-up or a short extension you can approve so we can finish the evaluation? Ideally something small (5k–15k token-equivalent) or an extra 7–14 day window would keep the PoC moving. We’d also appreciate a quick checklist or a short call to walk our infra person through best practices so we don’t hit the same snag again.

Customer: EllipsesAI (NDA in place)
PoC owner: Sara Lim
Timeline: want to finish by Oct 12 if possible

Appreciate any help — low-friction options are best.

—
Sara Lim
Head of Integrations, EllipsesAI
sara@ellipses.ai
